# MPI003 `irecv-buffer-used-before-completion`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

The buffer of a pending `mpi_irecv` is used before the request is completed.

## Why

Until `mpi_wait`/`mpi_test` completes an `mpi_irecv`, its buffer holds undefined data: the message
may arrive before, during or after the access. Reading it gives stale or partial values, writing it
may be overwritten by the incoming message. Complete the request first.

## Reported

```fortran
call mpi_irecv(halo, n, MPI_REAL8, src, 0, comm, req, ierr)
q(0) = halo(1)              ! the message may not be there yet
call mpi_wait(req, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE, ierr)
```

## Preferred

```fortran
call mpi_irecv(halo, n, MPI_REAL8, src, 0, comm, req, ierr)
call mpi_wait(req, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE, ierr)
q(0) = halo(1)
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[MPI003] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = MPI003` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).
